description: Claude Code usage analytics: tracks cost, token consumption, API requests, tool usage, sessions, active coding time, lines of code, commits, code edit acceptance rate, per-user breakdown, and error details. Data sourced from Application Insights via OpenTelemetry.

panels.description: Total cost in USD across all models

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "api_request"
| project timestamp, cost = todouble(customDimensions["cost_usd"])

panels.description: Per-tool reliability and latency. Sort ascending by SuccessPct surfaces the worst offenders.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "tool_result"
| extend tn = tostring(customDimensions["tool_name"]),
         s = tostring(customDimensions["success"]),
         d = todouble(customDimensions["duration_ms"])
| summarize Total = count(),
            Failures = countif(s != "true"),
            p50_ms = round(percentile(d, 50), 0),
            p95_ms = round(percentile(d, 95), 0)
            by Tool = tn
| extend SuccessPct = round(100.0 * (Total - Failures) / Total, 1)
| project Tool, Total, SuccessPct, Failures, p50_ms, p95_ms
| order by Total desc

panels.title: Tool Success Rate & p95 Latency

panels.description: MCP server connection outcomes. High FailPct flags servers that often refuse or drop connections.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "mcp_server_connection"
| extend sn = tostring(customDimensions["server_name"]),
         st = tostring(customDimensions["status"])
| summarize Total = count(),
            Connected = countif(st == "connected"),
            Failed = countif(st == "failed"),
            Disconnected = countif(st == "disconnected")
            by Server = sn
| extend FailPct = round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 1)
| project Server, Total, Connected, Failed, Disconnected, FailPct
| order by FailPct desc, Total desc

panels.title: MCP Server Health

panels.description: Top 20 prompts by total cost (joining user_prompt to api_request via prompt.id). Attributes spend to specific questions.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let api = traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "api_request"
| extend pid = tostring(customDimensions["prompt.id"])
| summarize Cost = round(sum(todouble(customDimensions["cost_usd"])), 2),
            Requests = count()
            by pid;
let prompts = traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "user_prompt"
| extend pid = tostring(customDimensions["prompt.id"])
| summarize When = max(timestamp),
            Prompt = any(tostring(customDimensions["prompt"]))
            by pid;
api
| join kind=inner prompts on pid
| project When, Cost, Requests, Prompt = substring(Prompt, 0, 100)
| order by Cost desc
| take 20

panels.description: Tool calls the user rejected (decision != "accept"). High ExitPlanMode rejections mean you sent the agent back to plan.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "tool_decision"
| where tostring(customDimensions["decision"]) != "accept"
| extend Tool = tostring(customDimensions["tool_name"])
| summarize Rejected = count() by Tool
| order by Rejected desc

panels.description: Summary of each user's activity including sessions, prompts, tool calls, cost, tokens, active time, and lines of code

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let tool_usage = traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "tool_decision"
| summarize totalToolCalls = count() by userId = tostring(customDimensions["user.id"]);
let prompts = traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "user_prompt"
| summarize totalPrompts = count() by userId = tostring(customDimensions["user.id"]);
let api_reqs = traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "api_request"
| summarize totalApiRequests = count(), totalCost = sum(todouble(customDimensions["cost_usd"])), totalTokens = sum(todouble(customDimensions["input_tokens"]) + todouble(customDimensions["output_tokens"])), totalActiveTimeSec = sum(todouble(customDimensions["duration_ms"])) / 1000.0, totalSessions = dcount(tostring(customDimensions["session.id"])) by userId = tostring(customDimensions["user.id"]);
let api_errs = traces
| where message startswith "claude_code."
| where customDimensions["event.name"] == "api_error"
| summarize totalApiErrors = count() by userId = tostring(customDimensions["user.id"]);
let loc = customMetrics
| where name == "claude_code.lines_of_code.count"
| extend changeType = tostring(customDimensions["type"])
| summarize linesAdded = sumif(value, changeType == "added"), linesRemoved = sumif(value, changeType == "removed") by userId = tostring(customDimensions["user.id"]);
let users = union
    (tool_usage | project userId),
    (prompts | project userId),
    (api_reqs | project userId),
    (api_errs | project userId),
    (loc | project userId)
| distinct userId;
users
| join kind=leftouter tool_usage on userId
| join kind=leftouter prompts on userId
| join kind=leftouter api_reqs on userId
| join kind=leftouter api_errs on userId
| join kind=leftouter loc on userId
| project User=userId, Sessions=totalSessions, Prompts=totalPrompts, ToolCalls=totalToolCalls, ApiRequests=totalApiRequests, ApiErrors=totalApiErrors, Cost=round(totalCost,2), Tokens=totalTokens, ActiveHrs=round(totalActiveTimeSec/3600.0,2), LinesAdded=linesAdded, LinesRemoved=linesRemoved
